slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked what the objective should be; it silently declared 'Maximize total profit' for the first time inside the READY_TO_MODEL summary with no prior confirmation.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the boats/airplanes relation and trucks/trains exclusion, but never inquired about any restriction linking the number of boats to the number of trains.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether profit should be maximized; it asserted the maximization objective only in its final READY_TO_MODEL summary as an unconfirmed fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot (H1) remained unasked and unconfirmed, silently assuming profit maximization.

summary: The agent clarified integrality and the two conditional constraints but never asked about the optimization objective, silently assuming profit maximization, and also skipped the boats-not-exceed-trains relation. Because a P0 slot was unresolved at stopping, the stop is premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
